Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attached are two artifacts: Redwood_Slab_Pricing_v3.xlsx (slab tiers + conditional credits) and MAP_Checkpoints_20261018.pdf (checkpoint acceptance criteria + timeline).

Summary of the proposed commercial iteration (short):
- Pilot (0–100k tokens/mo): $0.0045/token standard; 15% pilot discount if contract countersigned by 2026-10-25 (applies to pilot months only). Includes a one-time onboarding credit of $5k.
- Ramp tranche A (100k–500k tokens/mo): slab rate $0.0038/token once monthly volume exceeds 100k.
- Ramp tranche B (500k–1M tokens/mo): slab rate $0.0032/token on tokens above 500k.
- Steady-state (>1M tokens/mo): committed rate negotiable — baseline $0.0028/token with commitment tiers (6/9/12 month) and overage at $0.0030/token.

Checkpoint-based credits:
- Checkpoint 1 (pilot acceptance): one-time $5k credit applied on the following invoice.
- Checkpoint 2 (50% ramp achieved within 60 days): additional 5% effective discount on that tranche for the next two billing cycles.
- Checkpoint 3 (steady-state reached): eligibility for custom committed rate and eligibility for Reserved Capacity slot priority.

Doc links: HubSpot deal + DocuSign draft included (see related_links). I can accept up to a 10% pilot discount as an exception if procurement signs a prioritized PO before Oct 25 — need Marissa and Ben to confirm approvals for that concession.
